# Exploring Digital

> Exploring Digital gives small businesses, nonprofits and health tech companies a fractional CMO who designs the whole customer experience, not just the campaigns, then installs the AI-powered marketing engine that runs it. The client's team approves everything that goes out.

Exploring Digital LLC is led by Jamey Shiels, a fractional CMO based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, working with clients across the US. Jamey led enterprise marketing technology and operations at Advocate Health, one of the largest health systems in the country, and founded Wellcierge, a digital health company that was acquired. Best fit: firms with 20 to 250 people and real growth targets that lack senior marketing leadership, or have a team without a system, and want AI working in their marketing without losing control of what goes out.

Contact: jamey@exploringdigital.com, or book a 30-minute growth call at https://www.exploringdigital.com/contact.html

## Ways to work together

- [Marketing and AI Growth Assessment](https://www.exploringdigital.com/services.html#assess): 3 weeks, $7,500 to $10,000 fixed. Marketing audit, AI readiness score across eight areas, ranked opportunity map, 90-day growth plan and a data handling statement. Credited toward a Build or Lead engagement signed within 30 days.
- [90-Day Growth Engine Build](https://www.exploringdigital.com/services.html#build): 90 days, $20,000 to $30,000 fixed. Sharpened messaging, growth dashboard, AI-assisted content and outreach engine with approval rules, CRM and automation setup.
- [Fractional CMO](https://www.exploringdigital.com/services.html#lead): 1 to 2 days a week, 6-month minimum, $8,000 to $15,000 a month. Owns the marketing plan and results, leads the team and agencies, runs the engine, reports to the board monthly.
- [AI adoption leadership workshop](https://www.exploringdigital.com/services.html#workshop): half day, $3,500 to $7,500, drawn from doctoral research on AI adoption.

## Who it serves

- [Small businesses and nonprofits](https://www.exploringdigital.com/small-business.html): senior marketing leadership and a simple AI-assisted system a small team can run in a few hours a week.
- [Health tech](https://www.exploringdigital.com/health-tech.html): marketing that wins health system deals, from someone who sat on the buying side.
